label: Jurisdiction lists
rule: an id naming a list of places: jurisdiction, epscor, depscor, idea-eligible-state, epscor-state, county, economic-distress, priority-place, knight-community

label: Kinds of foundation
rule: an id naming a kind of grantmaker: private foundation, operating or non-operating foundation, community foundation, supporting organisation, donor-advised fund, corporate foundation, medical research organisation, congressionally chartered foundation, federated fund, giving circle, public charity

label: Non-profit tax standing
rule: an id naming tax-exempt status or how a non-profit holds it: 501c3, 501c4, group exemption, fiscal sponsorship, a negotiated rate or a federal-funding threshold for non-profits

label: Designated institutions
rule: an id naming a designation an institution or organisation holds: HBCU, HSI, tribal college, AANAPISI, NASNTI, PBI, land-grant, NLGCA, MSI, RCMI, Title III, community college, a certification, approval or designation, a named recipient, an existing grantee

label: Institutional profile
rule: none of the above: what an institution is or has (undergraduate-focused, not R1, domestic, foreign, eligible for a funder) as each funder tests it
